answer.body:
We temporarily disabled docs for languages other than English, German, Portuguese, Spanish and Russian.
We will enable them back as soon as we finish translating them with our new LLM-powered pipeline.

You can help us reviewing related PRs. Currently https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/pull/14545 is awaiting for reviews from Japanise native speakers - this is a LLM-prompt that will later be used to translate docs to Japanese
